collectie_herkomst: Archief van de Familie Van Daele-Nuytens, Gent, Belgie
provenance: Acquired by Baroness Elisabeth van der Meer in 1770 through inheritance from her grandmother, Baroness Maria van der Meer. Later sold to Count Floris van Wissenstein in 1825 as part of his marriage settlement with Countess Charlotte van der Meer. Transferred to the collection of Heren van Wissenstein by Count Floris's great-grandson, Hendrik van Wissenstein, upon his death in 1947.
